Liam — thanks for the packet and the CSV, helpful. Quick summary and recommended path below.

Short answer: portal-first, email-backstop.

Why portal-first:
- API/SFTP (portal) gives us deterministic ACKs (webhook + subject token) and better IDempotency for duplicate PDFs.
- Easier for us to enforce PO-matching rules and validate multi-PO lines before routing to finance.

Email backstop details (if you need a fast go-live):
- Use finance+vendors@redwood.example with subject token: REDW|SOL|{vendor_id}|{yyyyMMdd} (we'll parse and attach to the vendor record).
- Filename convention for attachments: INV_{PO|single}|{invoice_number}|{date}.pdf (e.g. INV_PO-12345-20260601.pdf). This helps our OCR pipeline reconcile.

CSV requirements (if you export CSV instead of PDFs):
- Required columns: invoice_number, invoice_date (ISO yyyy-mm-dd), currency, total_amount, line_description, line_amount, po_number (can be blank), remit_entity (if multiple, semicolon-delimited), tax_amount, contact_email.
- Optional but recommended: invoice_uuid (your system id), gross_to_net_breakdown.
- For multi-PO invoices: include one row per line with the same invoice_number and different po_number values. We strongly prefer normalized rows rather than embedding a JSON blob in a single cell.

Edge cases to call out:
- Zero-dollar line items: allowed but must have line_amount = 0 and a reason column (zero_reason).
- Credit notes: send as separate documents with credit_reference column.
- Multi-entity remittance: include remit_entity column and we will map to payment entity; if ambiguous, the portal route allows pre-validation.

Next steps I propose:
1) If Solstice can stand up SFTP/API this week, we will enable portal ingestion and generate a test token by Thu 07/24.
2) If not, use the email backstop subject token above and send a sandbox CSV to this thread for a one-off parse test.

I'll loop Vanessa to confirm SLA for ack times and Kimberly for PO-stamp policy.

Thanks,
Priyom

Liam — quick follow-up on SLAs and PO stamping:

Portal SLAs (what you'll see):
- Ingest ACK: within 60s for API uploads (webhook + acknowledgment tag).
- Parse & preliminary PO-match: within 15 minutes for typical CSVs <1,000 lines.
- Final acceptance (passed validations and queued for payment ops): within 24 hours for edge-case heavy files.

Email backstop behavior:
- If you email finance+vendors@redwood.example with the REDW subject token, you'll get an auto-reply confirmation within ~5m. Attachments are queued for OCR; large PDFs may be delayed for manual review.
- Important: subject token is mandatory for automated routing. Without it, the email goes to manual intake and could delay processing by multiple days.

PO stamping policy (Kim will confirm exceptions):
- Standard: we prefer PO number present on invoice (po_number column or visible on PDF). If missing, we try to match by amount + supplier + remittance within a 3-day window and mark as exception.
- For multi-PO invoices we require clear per-line PO mapping (CSV preferred). For PDFs, include a separate cover sheet listing invoice_number -> PO mapping.

Attachment note: We reviewed your CSV and a few things popped up (see inline comments in the attached sample). If you can push a corrected CSV to the test SFTP path, we'll run it through our staging parse.

Vanessa Ortiz
